subject: SSO redirect loop after switching IdP to Entra ID

comments.body:
We moved our Halden app registration from ADFS to Entra ID today. About a third of users get
bounced between Halden and Microsoft login in a loop. Others are fine.

Thanks Karen. A loop like this usually means the new IdP sends a different NameID format. Halden
expects the email address format. Could you check the NameID / user identifier claim in the Entra
enterprise app and compare it with what ADFS sent?

That was it — Entra was sending user.userprincipalname and some of our UPNs don't match the email.
Switched to user.mail and everyone can log in.
Great, closing this. Glad it was quick!

subject: Shopify connector failing with 429 Too Many Requests

Here's the guide: https://help.halden.example/shopify-webhooks
Switched to webhooks, no more errors.

subject: SAML 'assertion expired' error for some users

comments.body:
Some of our users get "SAML assertion expired" when logging in, but if they try again a few
minutes later it works. Our IdP is ADFS.

Hi Rohan, this error means the assertion's NotOnOrAfter time had already passed when it reached
us. We allow 3 minutes of clock skew. Could you check whether your ADFS servers are syncing time
(NTP)? One server drifting is the usual cause when only some logins fail.
One of our two ADFS nodes was 5 minutes behind. Fixed NTP and the errors are gone.
